# Texiom

> Texiom is a Docker-based LaTeX compiler for Linux and WSL2. It builds any .tex file into a PDF with pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex (via latexmk) without installing TeX Live on the host; the only requirement is Docker and Bash.

Current version: 0.0.80.

Key features:
- Compile: `texiom -d DIR -f FILE.tex`, with `--engine`, `--watch`, `--pdf-only`, `--shell-escape`
- Watch mode: `texiom --watch` rebuilds on every save, so you can write in any editor
- Per-project config: `texiom.toml` next to the .tex file (file, engine, pdf_only, watch, shell_escape, apt, pip)
- Small first download: the default `slim` base image (core LaTeX, XeTeX, LuaTeX, biblatex, biber; roughly 330 MB) from GHCR; `--no-pull` forces a local build
- Packs: `texiom packs` lists optional extras (science, publishers, fonts-extra, lang-*, minted, inkscape, full, ...) (installed ones are marked [x]); `texiom add` / `texiom remove` install them once, globally (selection in ~/.config/texiom/packs)
- Clear missing-package errors: a failed build names the missing LaTeX package or tool and the pack that provides it, and offers to install it and retry
- Per-project extras: `--apt` / `--pip` (or the same keys in texiom.toml) install into a small cached layer on top of the image
- GitHub Action with engine, shell_escape, apt/pip, texiom.toml, PDF artifact upload, a pdf_path output and a choice of the `full` or `slim` image
- VS Code Dev Container, .deb / .rpm / tar.gz packages and an install script

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/README.md): Installation, usage, all options, texiom.toml, packs, missing-package help, extra packages, watch mode, GitHub Action, Dev Container
- [Full documentation](https://mrzahmadi.github.io/Texiom/llms-full.txt): README and CLI help in a single file
- [Website](https://mrzahmadi.github.io/Texiom/): Project landing page

## Source

- [texiom script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/texiom): CLI entry point (argument parsing, compilation); sourced libraries are in lib/ (image.sh, packs.sh, diagnose.sh)
- [Dockerfile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/docker/Dockerfile): Two targets on Ubuntu 24.04: slim (default base) and full (every TeX Live collection)
- [packs.conf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/docker/packs.conf): Catalogue of packs (name, group, description, Ubuntu packages)
- [action.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/action.yml): GitHub Action definition and inputs
- [VERSION](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrzAhmadi/Texiom/main/VERSION): Current version number
